title: CaTherine wheels from trees and Liouville quantum gravity
summary: A CaTherine wheel is a space-filling curve $f : S^1\to S^2$ such that for every closed interval $J\subset S^1$, $f(J)$ is homeomorphic to a closed disk and $f(\partial J)$ is contained in $\partial f(J)$. A CaTherine wheel gives rise to a pair of disjoint, dense topological trees in $S^2$ which roughly speaking lie to the left and right of $f$. We give necessary and sufficient conditions for a topological tree in $S^2$ to arise as one of these trees for some CaTherine wheel $f$.
